Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
Find quick answers to common questions about OptiKPI. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Contact us for personalized support.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is OptiKPI Copilot? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI Copilot is the built-in AI agent inside the OptiKPI iGaming CRM. It scans your entire player base every day, identifies churn risk, reactivation windows, and deposit opportunities — then builds segments, writes campaign copy, and executes campaigns automatically. No SQL, no dashboards, no manual analysis required.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How is OptiKPI different from other iGaming CRMs? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI is the only iGaming CRM with a built-in AI agent — OptiKPI Copilot — that proactively surfaces retention opportunities daily without your team having to look for them. Unlike generic CRM tools or other iGaming platforms, OptiKPI combines a real-time CDP, AI segmentation, campaign automation, gamification, and responsible gaming compliance in one platform built specifically for iGaming operators.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What campaigns can I run with OptiKPI? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI supports the full range of iGaming retention campaigns — welcome journeys for new depositors, churn-prevention triggers for at-risk players, reactivation flows for lapsed accounts, VIP escalation programmes, gamification missions, and bonus-efficient promotional campaigns. All delivered across email, SMS, push notifications, WhatsApp, and in-app pop-ups.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Does OptiKPI integrate with my PAM and game providers? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yes. OptiKPI connects with leading PAM systems (Player Account Management — the core backend that manages player registration, wallets, KYC, and compliance), payment providers, game aggregators, and third-party data sources. Our real-time CDP ingests gameplay events, transactions, and behavioural data — creating a unified player profile that updates in under a second. Contact us to confirm compatibility with your specific tech stack.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What pricing plans are available for OptiKPI? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI offers flexible pricing for iGaming operators of all sizes. Plans include player segmentation, multi-channel campaigns, dashboards, and automation workflows. Higher tiers add Advanced Reporting, Customer 360, and AI Copilot. Contact us for a customised quote based on your player volume and market.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a free trial or demo available? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI offers personalised live demos — no free self-serve trial, but every demo is tailored to your operator setup. Our team walks you through the platform, shows how OptiKPI Copilot works for your specific player base, and demonstrates ROI potential. Most sessions take 30 minutes. Book yours via the button above.

The iGaming CRM Platform Built Around the 
Player Lifecycle
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI is an iGaming CRM platform that helps operators collect, analyze, and act on live player data. Automate campaigns, improve retention, and deliver personalized experiences across the entire player lifecycle—from onboarding and activation to VIP management and reactivation.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Watch video (1:30)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Features
 
 
 
 
 
Your Complete CRM Toolbox
 
 
 
 
 
Featuring marketing automation tools and a real-time customer data platform, our retention marketing solutions transform complex data into actionable insights, driving customer engagement and sustainable growth.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Performance at a Glance
 
 
 
 
 
Drive results with our real-time dashboard. See your marketing impact, customer engagement, and business performance instantly. Make informed decisions faster, optimize strategies, and grow your business with clarity.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Laser-Focused Targeting
 
 
 
 
 
Boost conversions with precision targeting. Segment customers instantly based on behaviors and preferences. Deliver tailored messages that drive engagement and maximize results. Turn data into action, transforming leads into loyal customers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Precision Engagement
 
 
 
 
 
Execute winning campaigns across all channels. Set clear goals, automate schedules, and track ROI in real-time. Maximize engagement and financial impact with every message. Turn strategy into measurable success.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Effortless Automation
 
 
 
 
 
Supercharge your operations with smart automation. Deliver consistent, engaging customer experiences at every touchpoint. Streamline processes, eliminate manual tasks, and focus on driving growth. Turn complexity into simplicity, maximizing efficiency and impact.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Content Command Center
 
 
 
 
 
Launch campaigns faster with centralized 
content management
. Access all marketing assets and promo codes instantly. Streamline deployment, boost efficiency, and maintain control. Transform your content strategy from scattered to strategic in one powerful hub.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Individual Player Insights
 
 
 
 
 
Unlock the power of individual customer profiles. Track every interaction, preference, and behavior in real-time. Equip your teams with deep, actionable insights for each customer. Deliver truly personalized experiences that drive loyalty and maximize lifetime value.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Pivot-Style Insights
 
 
 
 
 
Transform data into decisions with customized analytics. Uncover key trends and opportunities instantly. Tailor reports to your exact needs, revealing the true impact of every marketing move. Turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that propel your business forward.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
From Insight to Action
 
 
 
 
 
Your all-in-one CRM and customer data platform. Leverage real-time insights, automate marketing, and boost retention. Turn data into action for lasting customer relationships and sustainable growth.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
Find quick answers to common questions about OptiKPI. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Contact us for personalized support.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is OptiKPI? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI is an all-in-one customer retention solution, blending a real-time 
Customer Data Platform
 with a robust CRM toolkit. It enables precise targeting, campaign automation, and data-driven insights across multiple channels. OptiKPI makes enterprise-level retention technology affordable for businesses of all sizes, enhancing customer interactions throughout their journey.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why choose OptiKPI? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OptiKPI offers affordable, enterprise-level CRM power. Our user-friendly platform provides real-time data sync, goal-driven campaigns, and deep customer insights. With flexible integration and advanced intelligence, businesses of all sizes can implement sophisticated retention strategies. Unlock your data’s full potential without breaking the bank—that’s the OptiKPI difference.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What campaigns can I run with OptiKPI?
